import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Data preprocessing: Convert 'Dt_Customer' to datetime
df['Dt_Customer'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Dt_Customer'], format='%d-%m-%Y')

# Calculate total spending
df['Total_Spending'] = df[['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']].sum(axis=1)

# Plot: Total Spending vs Income with hue based on Marital_Status
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='Income', y='Total_Spending', hue='Marital_Status', palette='Set2', alpha=0.7)

# Customizing the plot
plt.title('Total Spending vs Income by Marital Status', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Income', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=12)
plt.legend(title='Marital Status', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))
plt.grid(True)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
